input_markdown:
# Retries and Timeouts
## Basics
Retries can improve resilience for transient failures, but they can also amplify load and create cascading failures when combined with weak timeout policies.
## Core Risks
- retry storms during outages
- duplicated work when operations are not idempotent
- increased queue pressure and latency
## Good Practices
- set explicit timeouts
- retry only transient errors
- use backoff and jitter
- consider idempotency before retrying requests
